critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1394 lines (was 1353). Still recommend router split (auth, uploads, admin, chat, groups) — this is a repeat comment from iter3/iter4.
admin_cleanup_tests uses regex ^(test_|TEST_) with case-insensitive flag; the case-insensitive flag makes the first branch redundant but harmless. Consider simplifying to r'^test_' with $options='i'.
clear_public in server.py correctly omits 'videos'. Video upload endpoint /api/uploads/video is still exposed (kept for future) — as expected per problem statement.
CuentaSuspendida.jsx uses new Date(until).toLocaleDateString('es-CL', ...) which correctly renders Spanish month names (verified: '8 de julio de 2026').

Login.jsx correctly intercepts detail.startsWith('account_banned' / 'account_suspended') and navigates; but note detail.split(':', 2)[1] in JS returns only the FIRST piece up to first ':' due to JS split limit semantics — for ISO strings containing 'T12:34:56' the timestamp will be truncated. RECOMMENDATION: use detail.slice('account_suspended:'.length) instead. Current tests didn't catch this because the resulting until is still URL-encoded and the CuentaSuspendida page still shows a valid formatted date (it fell back to just kind text if until parse fails). This is a real bug worth flagging.

Privacidad section uses lucide-react Lock icon inside a green-bordered card. Problem statement mentioned '💚' emoji — implementation uses green border + Lock icon, which is semantically equivalent. Fine as-is.
